findings.title: Widget coordinates can persist a mixed pair after failed compensation or reentrant position writes
findings.reproduction: Start with persisted and in-memory position (10,20). Request (100,200), let the X storage write succeed, then refuse Y and both rollback writes. The actual helper returns false and retains old RAM, while storage contains (100,20), accepted as two numeric coordinates at next boot. A second recording-boundary case reenters after outer X with request (300,400); all writes succeed but durable coordinates become (300,200). Actual production owner was extracted verbatim into an isolated AHK probe; that native probe remains unexecuted. Executed Python source assertions verify the separate write and unchecked rollback mechanism; no native Registry state was changed.
findings.root_cause: windows/ui/wpm/wpm_config.ahk:_WPMWidget_StorePosition at lines306-327 writes X and Y through separate Store.Call operations, without tuple serialization. The failure branch discards both compensation receipts and retains no recovery obligation, despite its explicit promise that half-written pairs cannot reach next boot. Drag-end surface restoration uses unchanged RAM and coordinate loading accepts both valid integers.
findings.silent_failure: The initial persistence refusal is loudly reported, but failed compensation and the mixed durable pair are not acknowledged separately or retained for recovery. In the conditional reentrant-success schedule both operations return true, producing an unrequested tuple without any failure notice. Real Windows reentrancy timing was not executed or measured.
findings.regression_test: Run the real owner with recording native Storage ports, covering X/Y refusal, rollback false/throw and reentrant successful position changes at each write boundary. Require atomic tuple persistence or an exact retained recovery obligation, then exercise actual drag/reset/graph callers and next-boot readback on isolated Windows. Preserve the deliberate auxiliary-Storage location. Linux set_many is the comparison; macOS separate settings writes require their own independent ownership review.
findings.additional_property: Consistency of an explicitly promised durable coordinate pair and acknowledged compensation.
findings.integration_qualification: Primary retained schedule is refused second write plus refused compensation, source-derived. Initial failure is logged; durable mixed pair/recovery debt is not acknowledged. The reentrant-success schedule is conditional native timing evidence, not independently executed proof of G3.
